sentences.text: This creature reached a total length of approximately 2 meters.
Its body mass was estimated at roughly 40 kilograms.
Remains were found in 2004 inside the Adamantina Formation of the Bauru Basin in Brazil.
The species was officially named in 2007 and placed within the family Peirosauridae.
Studies of its skull shape indicate it could generate bite forces ranging from 828 to 1013 Newtons.
Scientists believe it moved on a semi-upright posture to hunt on land.
The animal belongs to the family Peirosauridae.
It is part of the superfamily Mesoeucrocodylia.
Montealtosuchus is classified as an archosaur.
It inhabited the environment during the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages of the Late Cretaceous.
These fossils date back to about 90 million years ago.
Some researchers, including Michael J. Ryan, suggest this animal might be a transitional form between ancient crocodylomorphs and modern crocodiles.
